Standard **Frappe app layout**. The Python package is `healthcare/` and the module is `healthcare/healthcare/`.

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `healthcare/hooks.py` | App wiring: `doc_events` (including the wildcard `*` hooks that create medical records on submit/cancel), `scheduler_events` (appointment reminders; daily status/validity/billing jobs), `override_doctype_class` (Sales Invoice → `HealthcareSalesInvoice`), `doctype_js`, jinja methods, install/migrate hooks, `on_login` role-based home page |
| `healthcare/healthcare/doctype/<snake_name>/` | ~138 DocTypes. Each folder holds `<name>.json` (schema), `<name>.py` (controller class extending `Document`), `<name>.js` (form script), optional `<name>_list.js`, and `test_<name>.py` |
| `healthcare/healthcare/utils.py` | Large shared module: billing items, invoice hooks, before_tests, barcodes |
| `healthcare/healthcare/custom_doctype/` | Overrides and hooks for ERPNext doctypes (Sales Invoice, Payment Entry) |
| `healthcare/healthcare/api/patient_portal.py` | `@frappe.whitelist()` endpoints used by the Vue portal |
| `healthcare/healthcare/{report,page,print_format,web_form,dashboard_chart*,number_card,workspace,onboarding_step}` | Frappe metadata artifacts (JSON plus small py/js) |
| `healthcare/controllers/` | Shared controllers (e.g. `service_request_controller.py`, `queries.py`) |
| `healthcare/regional/india/abdm` | ABDM regional integration |
| `healthcare/patches/` + `patches.txt` | Data migrations, versioned `v0_0`, `v15_0`, `v16_0`, split into `[pre_model_sync]` and `[post_model_sync]` |
| `healthcare/setup.py`, `install.py`, `after_migrate.py`, `uninstall.py` | Install, migrate and uninstall lifecycle |
| `healthcare/public/js/` | Desk JS bundle and shared form helpers |
| `healthcare/www/` | Website routes for the patient portal (`patient_portal.html/.py`, `patient-portal/`) |
| `patient_portal/` | Vue 3 + frappe-ui SPA source. The Vite build writes into `healthcare/public/...` and the `www/patient_portal.html` index |
| `healthcare/workspace_sidebar/` | Desk sidebar JSON definitions |
| `wiki/` | Feature design and usage docs |

**Call flow:** desk JS calls `frappe.call` against whitelisted Python methods. Doc controllers call each other through direct imports (`from healthcare.healthcare.doctype.X.X import ...`). Healthcare docs create and hook ERPNext Sales Invoice / Payment Entry, and ERPNext doc events call back into healthcare through `hooks.py`. The portal SPA uses `frappeRequest` resources against `healthcare.healthcare.api.patient_portal.*`.
